posts.name: Objulen
posts.cooked: I've heard the idea tossed around that Unity would make a good villain character, since she has the bots and related powers as an army of machines. There was a robot copy of her built in the Iron Legacy timeline, so maybe when she builds it in the main timeline it turned evil (Omnitron could infect it, maybe that's how Omnitron 6 or 7 are created) and started producing robotic copies of heroes and villains made so far, and some staples, like the mini-Defense Platform (if you thought Baron Blade hated those, just wait until he sees his robot copy...).
